shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----TREE-----" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100 && echo "-----PKG-----" && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat AGENTS.md

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "-----TRAPS-----" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "-----SRC-----" && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo "-----NM-----" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

grep -n -A 22 'Page Constructor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; echo "-----PM-----"; ls yarn.lock pnpm-lock.yaml package-lock.json 2>/dev/null; echo "-----NPM VIEW-----"; npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40
grep -n -i -B2 -A 20 'page-constructor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,80p

npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor @diplodoc/transform 2>&1 | tail -15 && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; echo "-----BLOCKS-----"; ls build/docs/blocks build/docs/guides build/docs/sub-blocks; echo "-----README SETUP-----"; grep -n -i -A 30 'required setup\|## Install\|## Usage\|Getting started' README.md | head -120

echo "=====HEADER=====" && cat build/docs/blocks/Header.md && echo "=====EXTFEATURES=====" && cat build/docs/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md && echo "=====BANNER=====" && cat build/docs/blocks/Banner.md && echo "=====README VITE=====" && grep -n -i -B2 -A 25 'vite-plugin-dynamic-import' README.md | head -60 && echo "=====PROVIDER=====" && grep -n -i -A 30 'PageConstructorProvider' README.md | grep -n -i 'theme\|projectSettings\|ssrConfig\|locale' | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && echo "=====SASS=====" && ls -d node_modules/sass node_modules/sass-embedded node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1; echo "=====BUTTON/TITLE TYPES=====" && grep -n -B2 -A 18 'export interface ButtonProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts | head -60; grep -n -A 8 'export interface TitleProps\b\|export interface TitleItemBaseProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts | head -40; grep -n -B1 -A6 'export type ButtonTheme\|export declare enum ButtonTheme\|ButtonTheme =' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts | head -20; echo "=====BANNER COLOR=====" && grep -rn 'color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.js | head -10; echo "=====PROVIDER THEME=====" && grep -n -i 'theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=====CONTENT TYPE=====" && grep -n -A6 'export interface PageContent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/common.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn allow-scripts\|audit' | tail -5; grep '"version"' node_modules/sass/package.json node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import/package.json

echo "=====PageContent export=====" && grep -rn 'PageContent\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts | head -5; grep -n -A5 'export interface PageContent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts | head -12; echo "=====index exports=====" && grep -n "export \* from './models\|export \* from \"./models\|models" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; echo "=====BannerCard theme=====" && sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.js; echo "=====Header centered/theme=====" && grep -n 'theme\|centered' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.js | head -20

grep -rn -B1 -A4 'enum Theme\b\|type Theme =' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts | head -20; grep -n 'Theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/index.d.ts | head

sed -i "s|import { PageConstructor, PageConstructorProvider } from '@gravity-ui/page-constructor';|import { PageConstructor, PageConstructorProvider, Theme } from '@gravity-ui/page-constructor';|; s|<PageConstructorProvider theme=\"light\">|<PageConstructorProvider theme={Theme.Light}>|" src/App.tsx && grep -n 'Theme' src/App.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15

echo "=====styles.scss=====" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/styles.scss; echo "=====README ~ / alias=====" && grep -n -i 'alias\|tilde\|~@gravity' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head; echo "=====other ~ imports in styles dir=====" && grep -rn '~' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/ | head

npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v '^    at ' | head -30; echo "=====url usage=====" && grep -rln "from 'url'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/ | head; echo "=====README vite/url=====" && grep -n -i -B3 -A12 "'url'\|node polyfill\|browserify" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head -40; ls node_modules/url node_modules/node-stdlib-browser node_modules/vite-plugin-node-polyfills 2>&1 | head -3

echo "=====utils/url.js=====" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js | head -40; echo "=====README vite section=====" && sed -n 495,530p node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md; echo "=====install url polyfill=====" && npm install -D url 2>&1 | grep -v 'allow-scripts\|audit\|^$' | tail -3; grep '"version"' node_modules/url/package.json; node -e "console.log(require.resolve('url/'))"
git status --short && echo "=====pkg diff=====" && git diff package.json && echo "=====gitignore=====" && cat .gitignore && echo "=====final App.tsx=====" && cat src/App.tsx
rm -rf dist && printf 'dist/\n' >> .gitignore && git status --short
